citations.assessment: The local Akiva ben Dosa entry gives a reciprocal pointer to Yaakov ben Dosa without assigning a specific kinship.

The underlying passage calls him Yaakov ben Dostai. It gives three mil as the Lod–Ono distance, then reports that he walked in fig honey up to his ankles. Heilprin’s shoulder and compressed distance statement are retained with this witness note.
The Yerushalmi gives bar Dasai in the first halakhah of the named Sanhedrin chapter.
